project.name: Microfluidics Workstation Automation
project.description: Cross-platform desktop application for controlling and automating microfluidic and acoustofluidic experiment workstations.

modules.name: Graphical User Interface
modules.description: Operator interface for device control, experiment configuration, image preview, and logging.

requirements.title: Main Window Layout
requirements.description: Provide a main window with a menu bar, toolbar, central workspace, and dockable device control panels.

requirements.title: LED Control Panel
requirements.description: Panel to control LED light source: on/off toggle, intensity slider, and status indicator.

requirements.title: Syringe Pump Control Panel
requirements.description: Panel to control Nemesys syringe pump: set flow rate, volume, start/stop infusion, refill, and display current state.

requirements.title: Frequency Generator / Network Analyzer Control Panel
requirements.description: Panel to set frequency, amplitude, waveform, and sweep parameters for PZT excitation. Display S-parameter results for network analyzer mode.

requirements.title: Camera Control Panel
requirements.description: Panel to configure camera parameters (exposure, gain, ROI), display live preview, and control batch image capture.

requirements.title: XYZ Stage Control Panel
requirements.description: Panel to jog the motorized microscope stage in X, Y, Z axes, set absolute positions, and perform homing.

requirements.title: Device Status Dashboard
requirements.description: Display real-time connection status and health indicators for all connected devices.

requirements.title: Experiment Workflow Configuration
requirements.description: Allow users to define and save sequences of operations (e.g., set flow rate, wait, capture images, change frequency).

requirements.title: Logging and Error Reporting
requirements.description: Provide a log panel displaying timestamped events, warnings, and errors from all modules.

requirements.title: Settings Persistence
requirements.description: Save and restore application and per-device settings using QSettings across sessions.

requirements.title: Cross-Platform UI Consistency
requirements.description: Ensure the GUI renders correctly and behaves consistently on both macOS and Windows.

requirements.title: Image Batch Preview
requirements.description: Display thumbnails of captured image batches and allow users to browse and select images for analysis.

modules.name: Hardware Integration
modules.description: Device communication layer using vendor SDKs, serial protocols, and embedded interfaces.

requirements.title: Hardware Abstraction Layer
requirements.description: Define an abstract device interface that all hardware controllers implement, enabling mock and real implementations.

requirements.title: LED Driver Integration
requirements.description: Implement control for Thorlabs UPLEDUSB LED driver or custom power supply via USB/serial.

requirements.title: Syringe Pump Integration
requirements.description: Implement control for Cetoni Nemesys syringe pump using the Cetoni SDK.

requirements.title: Frequency Generator Integration
requirements.description: Implement SCPI-based control for frequency generators via VISA or serial.

requirements.title: Network Analyzer Integration
requirements.description: Implement SCPI-based control for vector network analyzers for S-parameter measurements.

requirements.title: Camera Integration
requirements.description: Implement frame acquisition using Basler Pylon C++ SDK with support for USB3 Vision and GigE Vision cameras.

requirements.title: XYZ Stage Motor Integration
requirements.description: Implement position control for motorized microscope stage via serial/USB protocol.

requirements.title: Device Discovery
requirements.description: Automatically detect connected devices on startup and allow manual connection configuration.

requirements.title: Thread-Safe Command Queuing
requirements.description: Queue device commands from the GUI thread and execute them on dedicated I/O threads to prevent UI blocking.

requirements.title: Error Recovery and Timeout Handling
requirements.description: Handle communication errors, timeouts, and device disconnections gracefully with user notification.

requirements.title: Platform-Conditional Device Support
requirements.description: Disable devices whose SDKs are unavailable on the current platform and clearly indicate this in the GUI.

modules.name: Analysis Tool
modules.description: Post-processing and analysis of acquired experimental data, inspired by tools like Gwyddion.

requirements.title: Image Batch Management
requirements.description: Load, organize, and navigate batches of captured images for analysis.

requirements.title: Particle Detection
requirements.description: Detect and locate particles in microscopy images using image processing algorithms.

requirements.title: Particle Tracking
requirements.description: Track particle positions across sequential frames to compute trajectories.

requirements.title: Velocity Computation
requirements.description: Calculate particle velocities and generate velocity field visualizations.

requirements.title: Focusing Efficiency Metrics
requirements.description: Compute statistical measures of acoustic or hydrodynamic focusing quality.

requirements.title: Separation Efficiency Metrics
requirements.description: Quantify the effectiveness of particle separation across channels or outlets.

requirements.title: Data Export
requirements.description: Export analysis results as CSV, annotated images, and summary reports.

requirements.title: Gwyddion-Style Visualization
requirements.description: Provide 2D and pseudo-3D visualization of data fields similar to Gwyddion software capabilities.

hardware_devices.sdk: SCPI commands over VISA or serial

hardware_devices.name: Network Analyzer

hardware_devices.name: Camera
hardware_devices.typical_hardware: Basler area-scan camera (USB3 Vision or GigE Vision)

hardware_devices.name: Motorized XYZ Microscopic Stage
hardware_devices.typical_hardware: Stepper or servo motors with motion controller

required.name: Qt
required.purpose: GUI framework, serial communication, image display, charting

non_functional_requirements.description: GUI must remain responsive (< 100ms input latency) during all device operations. All hardware I/O runs on background threads.
Application must build and run on macOS (ARM64, x86_64) and Windows (x86_64) from a single codebase.
All framework and library dependencies must be LGPL-compatible or more permissive. Proprietary vendor SDKs are acceptable for hardware drivers only.
Code follows C++20 best practices. Modules are loosely coupled via abstract interfaces. Each device controller is independently testable with mock implementations.
A researcher with basic computer skills should be able to operate all devices through the GUI without command-line interaction.
Device disconnection or communication failure must not crash the application. The system must recover gracefully and notify the user.
Adding support for a new device type requires implementing the device interface and adding a GUI panel — no changes to core architecture.
